notes: In-wall 3.5" touchpanel keypad with built-in control processor (discontinued by RTI, now part of AVPro Global after brand consolidation; rticontrol.com now redirects to avproglobal.com). Desktop/in-wall device, not rack-mountable, so rackUnits omitted. Power, the 4 relays, and 6 sense inputs share a single Phoenix-style (euroblock) terminal block per the official wiring diagram ("Power/Relay/Sense" connector) — modeled here as separate logical ports since each carries a distinct signal class. IR output is a 2-wire control port (200mA, drives up to 1000ft) also off this control-port wiring; modeled as its own port using the closest available connector id (ir). USB programming port is specified as "USB A to Mini B" in RTI's Quick Reference Guide; Mini-B is not in the allowed connector enum so it is recorded as usb-b (closest available) — actual connector is USB Mini-B, no data-rate grade stated. The 2 RS-232 ports use RJ-45 jacks (unit ships with 2x RJ45-to-DB9 adapters); no baud/grade concept applies to RS-232 so no grade set. Ethernet port is 10/100 Base-T with 802.3af PoE (Class 3) — graded eth-100m since no gigabit is stated. Built-in camera, microphone, and speaker are internal components (not external I/O ports) and are omitted. Integrated 802.11b/g/n WiFi and 802.15.4 Zigbee 2.4GHz RF are wireless, not physical ports, and are omitted. Power spec varies slightly across RTI documentation: official spec table states "+12VDC to +16VDC, 1A max" while the Quick Reference Guide states ".5A" — used the spec-table figure as primary source.

ports.name: Power (+12-16VDC)
ports.note: Phoenix-style terminal block, shared with Relay and Sense Input terminals; +12VDC to +16VDC, 1A max. Can alternatively be powered via PoE on the Ethernet port.

ports.name: Relays
ports.note: Four (4) dry-contact relay outputs, 3A @ 30VDC, on the same terminal block as Power/Sense

ports.name: Sense Input
ports.note: Six (6) voltage/contact-closure sense inputs, 3-24VDC, on the same terminal block as Power/Relays

ports.name: IR Output
ports.note: One (1) 2-wire IR control port, 200mA output, drives up to 1000ft (300m) of wire

ports.name: Serial Port 1
ports.note: RS-232, 3-wire, with status feedback polling; ships with RJ45-to-DB9 adapter

ports.name: Serial Port 2
ports.note: RS-232, 3-wire, with status feedback polling; ships with RJ45-to-DB9 adapter

ports.name: USB Programming Port
ports.note: Actual connector is USB-A to Mini-B per RTI documentation; Mini-B not in allowed connector list, recorded as closest available (usb-b)
